name: smui — Terminal Theme for the CAD Viewer UI
title_zh: 终端里跑 CAD 预览，不切窗口不改键位
tagline_zh: 建模时眼睛不用离开命令行——渲染预览直接铺满终端，改完参数立刻看形状，省掉来回切换的十几秒，手不离键盘。
tagline_en: See your model update right under your cursor — no alt-tab, no GUI lag. Tweak and check in one place, keep your.
desc_en: A library of agent skills for CAD, CAE and CAM
why_zh: 把 CAD 预览塞进终端，等于把「看结果」和「改参数」压进同一个注意力通道，打断感少一半。
why_en: It collapses the feedback loop by putting the render where you already type — less context switching, faster iteration.
limit_zh: 只适配 text-to-cad 的预览 UI，不通用其他 CAD 工具；依赖终端真彩支持，老终端会偏色。
limit_en: Only for text-to-cad previews. Needs truecolor terminal. Shows geometry only, not a full renderer.
title_en: CAD preview rendered inside your terminal, no window.
